ArchitectureConstraint.description:
#ArchitectureConstraint is one basic token or two basic tokens separated by a
slash. #ReleaseIndex additionally limits each token to 128 ASCII bytes.

BasicTokenConstraint.description:
#BasicTokenConstraint is a basic token: 1 to 128 ASCII bytes that match
^[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*$.

ContentSizeConstraint.description:
#ContentSizeConstraint is a string matching ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$.
#ReleaseIndex additionally caps its numeric value at 9223372036854775807.

FileEntryAnnotationsShape.description:
#FileEntryAnnotationsShape defines file-entry annotation constraints used by
the JSON Schema projection. The generator may omit constraints it cannot
represent.

io.imgoci.compression.description: io.imgoci.compression is the decoder applied to the stored file.

io.imgoci.content.digest.description: io.imgoci.content.digest is the SHA-256 digest of the decoded content.

io.imgoci.content.size.description:
io.imgoci.content.size is the byte length of the decoded content, encoded as
a string matching ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$.

io.imgoci.name.description: io.imgoci.name is a stable product identifier when present.

io.imgoci.representation.description: io.imgoci.representation is the deliverable representation selector.

org.opencontainers.image.title.description: org.opencontainers.image.title is a safe basename for the decoded content.

FileEntryDescriptorShape.description:
#FileEntryDescriptorShape defines the closed file-entry descriptor and local
field constraints used by the JSON Schema projection.

annotations.description: annotations describes the file entry and its decoded content.

digest.description: digest is the SHA-256 digest of the referenced file manifest.

mediaType.description: mediaType identifies the referenced object as an OCI image manifest.

size.description: size is the byte length of the referenced file manifest, not the file content.

IndexAnnotationsShape.description:
#IndexAnnotationsShape defines release-index annotation constraints used by
the JSON Schema projection. The generator may omit constraints it cannot
represent.

io.imgoci.architecture.description: io.imgoci.architecture is an architecture selector when present.

io.imgoci.compression.description: io.imgoci.compression is a decoder applied to a stored file when present.

io.imgoci.content.digest.description:
io.imgoci.content.digest is a SHA-256 digest of decoded content when
present.

io.imgoci.content.size.description: io.imgoci.content.size is the byte length of decoded content when present.

io.imgoci.name.description:
io.imgoci.name is the stable product identifier shared by all releases of
that product.

io.imgoci.representation.description:
io.imgoci.representation is a deliverable representation selector when
present.

io.imgoci.role.description: io.imgoci.role is a file role when present.

io.imgoci.target.description: io.imgoci.target is a target selector when present.

org.opencontainers.image.version.description:
org.opencontainers.image.version is the producer-assigned release version.
It is metadata; imgoci defines neither a tag mapping nor version order.

ManifestSizeConstraint.description: #ManifestSizeConstraint is a JSON integer from 1 through 9007199254740991.

ReleaseIndexShape.description:
#ReleaseIndexShape defines the closed release-index object and local field
constraints used by the JSON Schema projection.

annotations.description:
annotations labels the release index with its stable product identifier and
producer-assigned release version. It may contain other OCI annotations.

artifactType.description: artifactType identifies the object as an imgoci v1 release index.

manifests.description:
manifests contains one file-entry descriptor for each transport
alternative. It must contain at least one file-entry descriptor.

mediaType.description: mediaType identifies the object as an OCI image index.

schemaVersion.description: schemaVersion identifies the OCI image-index schema version and must be 2.

ReleaseVersionConstraint.description:
#ReleaseVersionConstraint contains 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters and no
whitespace or control characters.

SHA256DigestConstraint.description:
#SHA256DigestConstraint is sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal
digits.

TitleConstraint.description:
#TitleConstraint is one safe path component containing 1 to 255 ASCII bytes
that match ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9._+-]{0,253}[a-z0-9])?$.

description:
#ReleaseIndexJSONSchema is the best-effort JSON Schema compatibility
projection. It preserves the closed object shapes and local field constraints
that CUE can translate without weakening #ReleaseIndex.
